original_question: Are the single-machine throughput problems 1|r_j|sum U_j and 1|r_j|sum w_j U_j W[1]-hard when parameterized by p_max, the maximum processing time?
target_in_paper: Section 3.3, Open Problem 3 (“Throughput or weighted number of tardy jobs”).
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper’s exact target: it identifies the correct two single-machine problems with release dates, the exact parameter p_max, and the precise complexity question asked in the paper, namely W[1]-hardness.
missing_details: State explicitly that this is the standard nonpreemptive single-machine setting in Graham’s three-field notation; preemption is not allowed unless explicitly written, and here it is not.
Define p_max explicitly as p_max := max_j p_j, where p_j is the processing time of job j.
Define U_j explicitly as the tardiness indicator: U_j = 1 if job j is tardy (i.e., completes after its due date d_j) and U_j = 0 otherwise.
Make explicit that jobs have release dates r_j and due dates d_j, and that the weighted version additionally has job weights w_j.
If you want the question to be fully paper-faithful, note that the paper phrases these as weighted-number-of-tardy-jobs problems, while also stating that this is equivalent to maximizing throughput.
refined_question: For the nonpreemptive single-machine scheduling problems with release dates r_j and due dates d_j, where each job j has processing time p_j, and in the weighted case also weight w_j, let U_j be the indicator that job j is tardy (U_j = 1 if its completion time exceeds d_j, and U_j = 0 otherwise), and let p_max := max_j p_j. Are the problems 1|r_j|∑U_j and 1|r_j|∑w_jU_j W[1]-hard when parameterized by p_max?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, are the corresponding single-machine maximum-throughput problems with release dates—maximizing the number of on-time jobs, or the total weight of on-time jobs—W[1]-hard when parameterized by p_max := max_j p_j?
justification: This is the nearest official formulation in the paper: Section 3.3 explicitly poses Open Problem 3 asking whether the two release-date variants 1|r_j|∑U_j and 1|r_j|∑w_jU_j are W[1]-hard parameterized by the maximum processing time. Section 2 supplies the notation needed to make the question stand alone: processing times and release dates are part of the β-field notation, and Section 2.1.3 defines ∑w_jU_j and states its equivalence to throughput maximization. The extra context immediately after Open Problem 3 confirms that the intended scope is exactly this W[1]-hardness question (the paper notes that even XP-membership was open), so your draft should be sharpened mainly by making the notation explicit rather than by broadening or changing the problem.
